themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers various AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in their workflows, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, including vulnerabilities and best practices.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text into concise summaries for quicker understanding.

themes.name: AI design and prototyping
themes.description: Explores AI applications in generating designs, prototypes, and user interfaces, and their impact on design tools and workflows.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, employment levels, and the nature of work across various industries.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating software testing processes, improving efficiency and identifying quality issues.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles directly comparing the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI research tools and models.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates user interactions with AI chatbots, their accuracy, potential biases, and impact on user behavior and trust.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers how AI is used to extract, analyze, and leverage customer feedback and behavior data for business intelligence.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
